rows.label: qst630402_msg0001
rows.name:
Bonavento's group was assigned to
monitor the Superbian army in
Temperantia.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0002
rows.name:
We know they spent their first day
near Holy Grail Hammer in Temperantia.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0003
rows.name: Start by searching there for clues.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm counting on you, Hræsvelgr
Mercenaries.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0101
rows.name:
Good. You found Bonavento and the
others?

rows.label: qst630402_msg0104
rows.name:
If only we had delivered the message
better...

rows.label: qst630402_msg0105
rows.name:
But saving the other three was
excellent work.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0106
rows.name:
I'll hear the details from Goffredo
and the others. They should be back
soon.

rows.label: qst630402_msg0107
rows.name:
Thank you. That was work worthy of the
Hræsvelgr Mercenaries.
